name: Erin
source:
"If I have to abandon my humanity then I might as well die."

Just your average woman, Erin has lead a normal life until now and while at first glance nothing about her really sticks out, she seems to have been born with some kind of sixth sense that has helped her avoid danger throughout her life.

She can be very stubborn and once she makes her mind up about something, it's hard to stop her.
